reason: A brand-new company with two founders and not one customer, and they want to sit between me and my callers? Nobody I know uses it, so I'm not paying 990 euros to be their guinea pig.
objection: If they go under or the forwarding breaks, my customers' calls end up nowhere and I don't even know it. And I don't like strangers fiddling with my phone and my number remotely.
would_change_my_mind: A tradesman I know personally using it for a few months and telling me it works and didn't mess with his number.
